name: Shiomi Ritsuka
source:
Shiomi Ritsuka has been a childhood companion of Sumito, sharing a home in their younger years. Balancing her role as a student, she also efficiently manages her duties as the secretary to Sumito's mother. Characterized by her cool demeanor and composed nature, Ritsuka favors logic over emotions, yet she's far from being unfeeling, experiencing life's usual ups and downs. Firmly believing in Sumito's destiny to lead Dream Garden, she's committed to honing her skills as a secretary, gearing up for the future.

Special Skill: Organizing and tidying
Hobby: Traveling
Likes: Looking after Sumito
Dislikes: Boredom
Academic Ability: Excellent (top of her class)
Athletic Ability: Not her strong suit
Housework: A pro in all but cooking
Weakness/Dislike: Insects (ironically, her aversion makes her quite knowledgeable)
